Michael Jackson - Dangerous (Original 1991 Master Recording)

This is the true original master recording of Dangerous. It was taken directly from the album's master recording tapes by MoFi.

Nonetheless, it has one issue; Jam exhibits an odd imaging error where the vocals are slightly shifted to the right, disrupting the original mix of the track. This may occur during the encoding stage, but the cause of the problem remains uncertain. To compensate for this, I suggest substituting it with the streaming version as it provides the ideal balance.

Aside from that, this copy is completely perfect. This is the finest rendition of this album you will ever listen to.

item.description:
Michael Jackson - Dangerous (Unreleased Bonus Cuts)

This disc contains previously unreleased content that was taken into account for the 2001 reissue of Dangerous. Nonetheless, none of the tracks are included, apart from "Monkey Business" and "Dangerous Alt." "Ver," which ultimately became included in The Ultimate Collection box set launched in 2004.

The complete disc was released from the mastering facility and is in lossless original quality. Contains "Happy Birthday Lisa," the original version of the song Michael performed that was included in the 1991 episode of The Simpsons where he made a guest appearance.

Tracklist:
1. Bumper Snippet (Kid P.)
2. Monkey Business
3. Work That Body
4. If You Don't Love Me
5. Serious Effect
6. Happy Birthday Lisa
7. She Got It
8. Black Or White (Remix)
9. Dangerous (Alt. Ver)
10. Who Is It (Remix)
